probe_question: Given PHYS-R-002 (physics bridge, weight 0.7062) and the spectral phase transition in Q_n, is there a transitive morphism from C4-free hypercube structure to a physical system exhibiting the same Poisson-to-GOE transition at a predicted threshold?
answer: PHYS-R-002 is SPURIOUS — but a GENUINE morphism exists to Anderson localization

leg_1_literature.summary: Novel observation backed by Anderson theory. Poisson-to-GOE via level spacing is standard (Oganesyan-Huse 2007). No existing paper studies this on randomly-thinned hypercubes — confirmed novel via Perplexity (6 sources).

leg_2_positive_results.summary: p_c(n) characterized n=4..9 reproducibly. GOE plateau sharpens with n. Q_9 reveals two-phase structure — genuine discovery.

leg_3_generalization.summary: Needs tests on Z_3^n, random d-regular graphs, and p_c/p_perc convergence study.

leg_4_physics_experiment.summary: Mendoza Limit test designed but not run. Spectral transition as information channel, M_L as minimum edge density for spectral rigidity.

phys_r_002_assessment.name: Foucault Pendulum
phys_r_002_assessment.reason: No phase transition in Foucault pendulum physics. Similarity from generic fingerprint overlap (symmetry: Periodic, growth: Asymptotic). Not a physical morphism.

proposed_new_bridge.name: Anderson Localization on High-Dimensional Lattices
proposed_new_bridge.connection: Poisson-to-GOE spectral transition in randomly-thinned Q_n maps to Anderson localization/delocalization transition. Two-phase structure (percolation + delocalization) matches known three-regime picture in Anderson theory.
references: Anderson localization on Bethe lattice literature

key_discovery.name: Two-phase spectral transition in Q_9
key_discovery.description: Non-monotonic r(p) at n=9: pseudo-GOE (tiny components, p<0.10), Poisson dip (Anderson localized, 0.10<p<0.17), true GOE (delocalized, p>0.17). Invisible at n<=8.
key_discovery.novelty: No existing literature found (Perplexity search, 6 sources)

scaling_revision.ratio_trend: Decreasing — two distinct transitions (percolation + delocalization) merge for small n, separate for large n

recommendations: Flag PHYS-R-002 as spurious in erdosatlas.db (needs schema update)
Leg 3: Test on Z_3^n or random d-regular graphs (T3-086-b)
Leg 4: Mendoza Limit experiment on spectral channel
n=10 extension (~5 min compute) to confirm Poisson dip deepens
Publishable: Q_9 two-phase discovery as standalone note
